title: Article 381 — Council of Ministers of the President (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 381 was a transitional provision for the Council of Ministers of the President. Omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent; not living law.
content.glance: Art 381 omitted by 7th Amendment 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Transitional Council of Ministers — spent.
content.study: Part of the 379–391 transitional block. Omitted by 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).

questionsAndAnswers.question: Status of Article 381?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Omitted by the 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
